summary: This PR narrows default generic parameters on `Factory`/`createFactory` from `any` to `Env`/`string`, and adds an explicit return type annotation to `Factory.createMiddleware`. It's a type-only fix (no runtime logic changed — the function body still just returns the passed-in middleware), targeted at issue #3847 where the middleware's inferred type was too loose (falling back to `any`). New type-level tests were added to lock in the correct behavior.
